question: The 90th edition of the Ranji Trophy started in October 2024. Which of the following games is the Ranji Trophy related to?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cricket**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ranji Trophy:-**

 
 
• **It is the premier domestic first-class cricket championship played in India. (Hence option 4 is correct)**
 
• The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) annually organizes it.
 
• The teams representing regional and state cricket associations participate.
 
• The competition currently consists of 38 teams, with all 28 states in India and four of the eight union territories having at least one representation.
 
• Some of the most successful teams in the history of the Ranji Trophy:
 
 
• Mumbai (41 titles)
 
• Karnataka (8 titles)
 
• Delhi (7 titles)
 
• Maharashtra (7 titles)
 
• Tamil Nadu (6 titles)
